prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin with only one test completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- sign_in, reorder: -2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen: Add a new screen called new_desktop_guide before home_intro that outlines basic desktop pet controls and tray shortcut features. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
1: [home, new_flow] Live Pet Creation Progress Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive spotlight stage with dynamic progress, estimated time remaining, and helpful tips. (why: The waiting screen target step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs from users thinking the process stalled.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Sync Assurance Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign_in screen confirming that signing in restores and preserves existing pets and items. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Readiness Alert: Enable background ready notifications and time estimates on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the app. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing or app not opening, while generation waiting time is long (mean 2336s).)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Overlay Visibility Instructions: Update home_intro text to clearly instruct users how to reveal or unhide their desktop pet if display permissions suppress it. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on desktop or app will not open.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Centered Story Mascot Welcome: Switch the story screen layout to centered with an animated mascot introducing the desktop pet concept. (why: Mean duration on choose_path is 514s, suggesting users need a clear visual introduction before picking a path.)
